digest.component_or_area: CI testing infrastructure / pytest timeout configuration
propositions: The per-test hang budget was reduced from 300s to 20s by story 73b8, but ~14 whole-tree-scan tests legitimately cost 18.7–29.93s on covered CI legs, placing the budget inside the band of legitimate costs.

With timeout_method=thread, pytest-timeout expires a test via os._exit(1) (killing the xdist worker) rather than pytest.fail(), so worker crashes produce zero 'Failed: Timeout' lines—the zero timeout verdicts observed in failing runs are a mechanism prediction, not evidence against expiry.

The Verified gate executes workflow files from trusted main (not the patchset), so a patchset-only ini=300 restore cannot exercise itself; the stale CLI --timeout=20 flag from main overrides the patchset's ini change (pytest-timeout precedence: CLI > INI).

Restoring timeout=300 in both pyproject.toml and _build-and-test.yml lanes with explicit --timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread flags fixes the regression and provides >10x headroom against measured costs.

Post-merge verification runs at commit a42a9d8d494 show zero worker-crash lines and successful completion of all pytest legs, including the coverage-instrumented ubuntu-latest py3.13 leg where 11–14 workers previously died every run.
